description: Speaks to the user. Owns the response prompt.
purpose: Produces the actual chat message the user sees. Every crew that should respond to the user needs at least one Talker. Place it at the END of the main lane (after extractors, routers, and any other addons) so it has the full picture of what this turn's processing produced — including memory writes from upstream extractors. Without a Talker the crew is silent — useful for intake-only steps like classify-then-route, but rare. Phase B: the Talker's prompt is one mention-aware string. Use {{persona}} to pull in the agent persona, {{memory}} or {{memory:domain}} for memory, {{thinking}} or {{thinking:domain}} for the Thinker's plan, {{field:name}} for a single inline value, and {{param:name}} for static agent parameters. Web search (task #967): config.webSearch = { enabled, allowedDomains?, maxSearches? } turns on the model provider's own web search tool (OpenAI and Anthropic models only; ignored on Gemini). It searches ONLY where this prompt allows it: the runtime adds a built-in rule (search only when the prompt explicitly allows or asks for a web search, and only for what it allows), so a prompt that never mentions web search never searches. Grant it with a line such as 'Search the web for current exchange rates when asked.' A turn that does not search pays no search fee. It searches, reads and answers in this one call. allowedDomains (optional, plain domains like "gov.il") limits the search to those sites; maxSearches caps the searches per turn (default 3, max 10). Each search costs about $0.01 plus the pages read, billed as input tokens. Queries and sources show on the run card.
